activity_context.topic_title: Sums of Finite Geometric Series Given in Sigma Notation

feedback.worked_solution:
Since the given series is in the form ${\sum }_{n=1}^{N}{a}_{1}{r}^{n-1},$ it is a geometric series. 

To determine the sum, we use the formula for the sum ${S}_{N}$ of a geometric series.

$$
{S}_{N}={a}_{1}\frac{(1-{r}^{N})}{1-r}
$$

In this case, ${a}_{1}=\frac{1}{3},$ $r=5$ and $N=6.$ If we substitute these values into the formula for ${S}_{N}$, we obtain the following:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\sum }_{n=1}^{6}\frac{1}{3}(5)^{n-1} & =\frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{(1-{5}^{6})}{1-5} \\  & =\frac{1}{3}\cdot \frac{(-15\,624)}{(-4)} \\  & =1\,302\end{aligned}
$$
